scope: Shared runtime layout and NEXT/BACK; metadata-only Android original/PK02 regression, not a route-clear claim.
known_limits: Normal WMV playback is not implemented by the current MPEG-1/MP2 decoder; NEXT skips movie presentation.
No full route clear or full six-game Android settings regression is claimed.
EXE files are read as data to detect the numeric ABI; no Windows game executable or DLL is executed.
The Android confirmation widget follows ViewDialog conditions but is not a recreation of dialog.mng.
No images or narrative were viewed; only technical metadata and device-side text hashes were inspected.
probe_corrections: Menu-edge coordinate rounding caused an extra dialogue advance in an excluded exploratory run; final probes tap button centers and verify dispatched page tokens.
am -W -S can return before pidof observes the replacement process; the probe distinguishes never-yet-observed from observed-then-lost processes.
Exploratory and pre-confirmation runs are excluded from the final same-APK result.
